༄༅/ /grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'bri tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru/grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'bri tshul la/dang po/gtso bo rdo rje 'chang

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'bri tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'bri tshul la/ dang po/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*/ yi dam mtshon byed khro bo mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs/ chos skyong mtshon byed mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ be ta'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa de'i rig ma yin par phyag g.yas kyi dang po gri gug gam mchog sbyin gang rung*/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra ba bya/ (1) grub thob rnams kyi sngon du lū yi pa ni cung zad sku sha skam po snga sangs mdun du nya'i rgyu lto spungs nas zhal du gsol ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug cung zad yod pa brang spu dang bcas pa/ ( 2 ) li lā pa ni rgyal po'i <'di yan gyi sku mdog mi gsal ba rnams ni mthing kha smug nag gi rnam pa can yin par mngon/> rnam pa can khri la bzhugs pa/ 'khor blon po dang btsun mo la sogs pas bskor ba'i rnam pa cung zad yod la/ (3) bir+wā pa ni yongs su grags pa bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ dbu co bregs la me tog gi phreng ba tsam ma gtogs rgyan med pa/ phyag g.yasasdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon pa ba men gyi rwa zhal chang gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ (4) ḍom+bi he ru ka pa ni sku la rus rgyan tshang ma yod pa/ phyag g.yas na dug sbrul gyi lcag 'dzin pa sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka can/ sku'i g.yon nas yum gyis 'khyud cing stag la chibs pa/ (5) shā bā ri pa ni sku sha nag po phyag g.yas na mda' dang*/ g.yon na 'od ma'i gzhu bsnam pa/ gzhu mchog lag par khog stod dang khog smad bkal ba rma bya'i mdongs gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i rgyan yod pa rig ma gnyis kyang rgyan gtso bo de 'dra ba'i rigs yin pas/ rgas 'khogs pa'i rnam pa mi bya'o/ / (6) sa ra na pa ni sku sha dkar ba tshangs skud can/ mda' srong ba grub pa'i slob dpon rgas pa med pa de 'dra ba'i rigs la/ rgas 'khogs pa'i rnam pa bya'o/ / (7) 'di pa lā ni dur khrod na bzhugs shing*/ mdun na keng rus nyal ba/

rgyan med pa/ dbu skra co bregs sku mdog sngo sangs mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ / (8) li na pa ni nya chen po'i khog pa gshag pa'i dbu nas thon pa'i tshul gyis zhabs gnyis ka'am gcig khog pa'i nang du chug tsam/ phyag gnyis gar mdzad pa'i tshul/ sku sha sngo sangs rgyan med cing skra 'dzings pa/ (9) go rak+ṣa ni skra bregs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag sku sha sngo sangs dkar ba snyan la mu dra nag po dang*/ mgul du rwa dung btags pa/ sku lus gcer bu'am/ tsan+d+ra kan+ta zhes bya ba 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po gshegs su gsol ba/ mdun du ba lang gi khyu mtshon byed/ (10) tsau ra gi pa ni dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs chung du yod pa/ shing drung na gnas shing mnyam bzhag byed pa/ logs gcig nas phar tshong bdag zhig gis tshong zog rnams/ sol bar song ba bris/ (11) bi na sa ni dzan tar du grags pa skud pa gsum yod pa'i rgyud can brdung zhing*/ thod bcings pa sogs rgyal po'i rnam pa can bya/ (12) shān+ti pa ni dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta cung bgres pa'i rnam pa can paṇa zhwa gsol ba/ (13) tiṇ+ta pa ni sma ra ring ba/ shin tu rgan po'i cha byad can/ khri thag 'thags pa/ (14) tsa ma ri pa ni lham bzo'i bya ba mdzad pa/ (15) garga pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs can ral gri thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ de'i nye bskor gcig na mchod rten gyi bu ga'i sgo nas sbrul chen po zhig lus phyed tsam thon pa 'bri/ mchod rten gyi nang nas sprin sprin tshogs kyi sku rib tsam mngon pa bris na legs/ (16) 'phags pa klu sgrub ni yongs su grags pa bzhin nam/ yang na sku sha sngo sangs shin tu mtshar ba lta bu la gtsug tor med pa/ dge slong gi cha byad sbrul 'go'i gdengs ka can du byas na don dang mthun zhing*/ ci ste mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mos na ni/ de 'ja' lus kyi sku yin pa'i/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad du byas na legs par mngon no/

/ (17) nag po spyod pa ni sku sha sngo sangs phyag na ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa nam mkha' gdugs bdun bdun rang 'khor dang*/ ḍā ma ru bdun 'khrol srin mo ro langs ma la chibs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gam stag lpags kyi smad dkris sogs ci ltar rigs pa 'bri'o/ / (18) ar+ya de wa ni dge slong shing kar+ṇa'i slob ma ste/ shing lo chen po zhig phyag na bsnams pa/ (19) tha ga pa ni g.yas g.yon phan tshun du nags tshal dang*/ grong khyer re re 'bri zhing*/ shing sdong gcig phyed bsnyes su bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du dge slong zhig 'greng nas gtam smra ba/ (20) nā ro pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/ mi pags gsol ba/ mi lpags kyi rkang lag gnyis nas phyag gis bzung nas zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ (21) bi ra lā pa ni rnal 'byor pa ce spyang gi ro phrag par bkal ba/ (22) tsan+d+ra tai lo pa ni sku sha sngo nag til brdung ba'i rnam pa can/ mdun du rig mas snod gcig nas til blug pa'i rnam pa can/ (23) tsan+d+ra pa ni pu ti rgyab du khur zhing pod chung zhig lag tu thogs pa/ rab byung gi cha byad can no/ / (24) bha tra pa ne phag sha dang chang bum mdun du bzhugs pa/ tshangs skud can/ skra shad bcings pa'i thor cog can/ rgyan sogs rin po che'i rgyan cung zad yod pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs brag stegs lta bu'i mtho ba na/ bla ma rnal 'byor pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can gcig bzhugs pa'o/ / (25) ru mkha' ru pa ni phyag dar khrod kyi gos lhan hrul po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas tshom bu mdzad pa/ (26) dzo ki pa ni dur khrod gcig tu 'phred nyal mdzad pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad yod pa/ (27) ka la kā pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad tsam dang gzugs mdzes pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ dur khrod na gnas pa'o/ / (28) hu li pa ni gzhong pa rnams su gos rnying pa 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can no/

/ (29) kaṃ ka na pa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can/ rang gi lag gdub la blta zhing 'dug pa la/ nam mkha' na lha dang lha mos mchod pa 'bul ba/ (30) koṃ pa la pa'i lwa ba pa ni sa la rang shong bzhin du sa brus pa'i kha mtshams nas mi mgo skam pos bskor ba'i dbus na gzims pa'am/ yang na brag phug na gzim pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa byas kyang rung*/ dge slong gi cha byad can no/ / (31) ḍeṅgi pa ni snod gcig tu 'bras blugs nas/ gtun shing gis 'bras bu sbru zhing chu la 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can/ phyogs gcig na chang tshong ma zhig yod pa bri/ (32) ban+dha sa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can zhig nam mkha' la dge slong lhung bzed 'khar bsil thogs pa 'gro ba la blta zhing*/ mdun nas lha'i bzo bos gtam smra ba/ (33) tin+tha pā ni sho rtse ba zhig 'bri/ sho brgyag pa gar lugs su byed/ (34) ku ku ri pa ni rus pa'i rgyan dang thor tshugs can/ bar du khyi mo yod pa 'bri/ (35) ku dzi pa ni mdun nas slob dpon klu sgrub yod pa/ ltag par lba ba skyed pa'i rnal 'byor ba gcig 'bri/ (36) dha mu pa ni bram ze'i cha byad pu ti mang po dang bcas pa/ (37) ma hi la ni yan lag sbom zhing sha sul can gzhan la lus stobs 'gran pa'i tshul can no/ / (38) aṇ+ḍi pa ni nags na shing kha gcod cing shing khur 'khur nas 'gro ba/ (39) ba bhi hi ni rgyal po'i rnam pa g.yon phyogs nas btsun mos 'khyud pa/ (40) ni lo pa ni pad+ma'i mtsho nas me tog pad+ma rtsa ba dang yan lag de gcod pa/ (41) bu su ku pa ni zhi ba lha ste mtha' dge 'dun gyis bskor ba'i khri steng nas nam mkha' la cung zad 'phags pa/ dge slong gi cha byad chos 'chad mdzad pa/ mdog dkar la dmar ba'i sha nyams rgyas pa'o/ / (42) in+d+ra bhu ti ni rgyal po'i cha byad la bud med glu dang rol mo bro gar byed pa mang pos bskor ba'o/ / (43) mi dgongs ni 'khar ba 'chang zhing kha zas sna tshogs pa'i don du bkres pa'o/

/ (44) tog tse pa ni dbu lwa thod bcings shing tog tses zhing tha rengs brkos pa'o/ / (45) kaṃ bha ri pa ni lcags mgar gyi las byed pa'i rnam pa can no/ / (46) dza lan dha ri pa ni rnal 'byor ba ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/ zhabs phyogs gcig nas dpung pa la bkal ba/ phyogs gcig bzhengs pa'i pus btsug phyag sor mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ gzhan rnams bsnol ba'i phyag rgya mdzad nas/ phyag rgya de mgo 'jug me tog gis spyi bor bcings pa phyogs gcig nas rig mas brten pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ (47) ra hu la pa ni dur khrod du 'dug cing sku sha sngo sangs yid tsam bgres pa/ dbu skra bregs pa phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag byas shing dur khrod kyi mi la lta ba zhig 'bri/ (48) dharma pa ni dge slong bgres po pu ti phyag na bsnams pa/ (49) dha ka na pa ni mdzo la'i nang du snod chen po zhig bcug nas slang mo slong ba'i tshul du bzhengs pa/ (50) bed dha pa ni glang gnyis la gnya' shing btsug nas zhing rmo ba'i rnam pa can/ (51) pad ka dza pa ni pad+ma'i rdzing bu'i 'gram nas spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang gcig yod pa la/ dge slong gcig gi mchod pa 'bul ba/ kho rang bram ze gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni spyan ras gzigs dang dbang phyug chen po nor ba'i lo rgyus yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar mor phyag g.yon na pad+ma g.yas de'i kha 'byed pa/ yum gyis g.yon nas 'khyud pa/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du rtse gsum dang thod pa bzhag pa'o/ / (5 2 ) dril bu pa ni slob dpon nyid rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs rus rgyan stag lpags ral pa'i thor tshugs sogs yod pa/ sku lus mi sha kha'am sngo sangs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa la/ yum ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos sku mdog dmar po'am gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ de yang nam mkha' la 'phur stabs sam bde mchog lhan skyes bzhin g.yon bskum byas kyang rung ste/

nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i mtshon byed du sprin gseb tu bzhugs pa/ 'og gi phyogs nas mtsho lud pas grong khyer gyi phyed tsam pa khyer ba dang*/ mtsho'i dkyil na kha sar pā ṇa'i sku'i phyed tsam thon pa 'bri/ (53) dzo gi pa ni rnal 'byor pa gcer bu 'khar ba thogs shing yo byad rnams phrag rgyug gi rtse la bkyon nas phrag khur thogs pa zhig 'bri/ (54) tsa lu ka pa ni rnal 'byor pa gcig la gri sngas su btsug nas nyal ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i gdan bting shing*/ mdun du bsnoms shing bskur ba/ (55) go ru ṭā sha ni smad la shing lo'i gos can dbu skra co bregs/ snyi btsugs te bya shor ba'i rnam pa can/ (56) lu tsi ka pa ni bram ze'i rnam pa can la skra dang kha spu 'jab tses btogs so zad zad gcig 'bri/ (57) nirbu ṇi pa ni mal khri la rgyab bsnyes snyam nas zas za ba/ mdun du rnal 'byor pa gcig yod pa 'bri/ (58) dza yon tan pa ni phyag na ting shag bsnams pa gtor ma sna tshogs gtong ba'i rnam pa can/ bya sna tshogs 'dus pa/ 'khor slob ma rdza rnga brdung ba dang*/ gling bu 'bud pa dang*/ sil snyan sgrogs pa dang*/ pi wang brdung ba sogs 'bri/ (59) pa tsa ri pa ni shing drung gcig na rnal 'byor pa skra bregs pa/ na bza' ka tso ri bya ba mdoms dkris gru gsum gcig las med pa/ snum khur phyed tsam za ba mdun du spyan ras gzigs de'i sprul pa dge slong gcig yod pa zhig 'bri/ (60) tsam+pa ka pa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can/ skyed mo tshal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ mtha' rnams shing tsam+bha ka ste yal ka rnams zlum por skyes pa/ lo ma ljang nag me tog ser skya yod pa/ (61) bhi k+ṣa ṇa pa ni phyag ni gu ba'i snod bsnams pa de'i mdun du mkha' 'gro ma dmar po zhi ba'i rnam pa can skra grol ba/ rus rgyan yod pa chos bstan pa'i rnam pa can/ grub thob de rang gis so bton nas mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba/ (62)

dhe li pa ni mar nag gi snod mang po bshams te 'tshong ba'i tshul dang*/ kha zas sna tshogs bshams pa/ mdun du paṇ+ḍi ta gcig gi chos ston pa'i rnam pa can/ (6 3 ) kum+bha ri pa ni rdza mkhan gyi rnam pa rdza bzo ba bud med dang bcas pa/ (64) tsa ru ṭi pa ni na bza' mi kha li gsol ba/ sel mi kha li ni rngul gzan 'dra ba'i dkyil nas mgo 'don pa yod pa la mgo bton pa/ phyed phyed mdun rgyab kyi gos yin pa la ska rags bcings pa'o/ /shing drung gcig nas me btang zhing du ba 'thul ba/ phyogs gcig nas bcud len gyi snod yod pa/ mi rnams la bcud len de nas shing lo gcig gis 'thor tshul byed pa/ mdun du bud med gcig dang byis pa gcig thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i sngas su ma mong zla bo'i tshul gyi yod/ de'i ltag tsam na brag phug gcig nas dbus su lha gcig /g.yas su lha chung ba gcig /g.yon du lha mo gcig rnams gdan gcig la sum sgrigs su 'dug pa 'bri/ (65) rnal 'byor ma ma ṇi bha ṭa bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i rnam pa/ 'og gi sa gzhi la chu bum chags pa gcig 'bri/ (66) rnal 'byor ma mi kha li ni gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ mchan du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skra grol ba zhal nas/ ral gri byung ba phyag g.yas pa'i 'dzin tshul/ phyag g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa zhig 'bri/ (67 ar+dha de/) (68) rnal 'byor ma ka na kha la ar+dha de dang 'dra ba las phyag g.yas na gri gug gam ral gri/ g.yon pas rang gi dbu bcad de bsnams pa 'bri ba yin pa la rang 'ga' zhig phal ba'i rnam rtog gis de 'dra 'bri ba mi spro na/ phag mo dbu bcad ma'i bris thang rnying pa 'ga' re la 'byung ba bzhin/ sku gzugs la yang dbu yod cing*/ phyag na yang dbu gcig bsnams pa bris kyang mi 'gal/ 'di gnyis kar nam mkha' la gar stabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du 'bri/ spyir rnal 'byor 'di gnyis mdzad pa 'dra ba byung bas bkod pa'ang 'dra rung bas chog go

/ (69) ka la pa ni kha dog sngo nag dur khrod nas byas pa/ de'i mdun mtho ba nas rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can zhig gis chos gsungs pa'i rnam pa can gcig 'bri/ (70) kan+dha li yar gos mtshams byed pa'i rnam pa can la mdun nas mkha' 'gro ma gcig gis chos ston pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ (71) dha hu li pa ni rtsa thag 'tshong ba'i rnam pa can 'bri/ (72) u ṭi li pa ni mgo la thod bcings shing lus la tso ma she gos phu rung can gyon pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thor tsam yod pa/ kha spu bzang po can nam mkha' la blta ba/ nam mkha' la sprin kha dog sna lnga pa la/ glang po dang*/ rta dang*/ bya la sogs pa'i srog chags kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dra rung gi dbyibs can yod pa/ de dang nye bar ngang dang ngang mo gnyis 'phur ba/ de'i mdun du rnal 'byor pa shing lo thogs pa gcig yod pa 'bri/ (73) ka pā li pa ni kha dog nag po dur khrod nas bud med kyi ro zhig yod pa'i thod breg te phyag na bsnams pa/ lus la rus rgyan cha tshang yod pa'o/ / (74) ki rat+na mo pa gi kha spu bzang ba khro nyams can/ mgo la cod paṇa zhes bya gcig dbus dang phyogs bzhi ste rtse mo lnga yod pa/ rin po che'i tog can skra mtshams la dpa' bo dar dpyangs zhes bya ba gser gyi 'khyud mo las rna ba'i ltag g.yas g.yon nas mar la dar dpyangs 'phyang ba/ ral gri dang phub 'chang ba khri la gnas pa/

(75) sa ka ri pa ni dge slong gi rnam pa can/ mdun nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bzhengs pa gcig 'bri/ (76) sarba bha nyā pa ni mdun du snod chen po gcig na zas bzang ngan sna tshogs blugs nas de za ba 'bri/ (77) nā ga bho dhi ni dge slong gi rnam pa can mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ de'i phyogs gcig gi brag phug zhig gi nang du rnal 'byor pa mgo la ri dwags kyi rwa skyes pa'i rnam pa can 'bri/ (78) dā ri ka pa ni rus rgyan can rdo rje dril bu brdung nas nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro ba/ 'og phyogs kyi sa zhig la grong khyer nas mi rnams kyi slob dpon la blta ba dang*/ rdo ring gi rtse na rdo'i glang chen gcig yod pa 'bri/ (79) pū ra li pa ni dgyes rdor thang kha bkram pa/ de'i mdun gyi phyogs nas rgyal po'i cha byad can gyis gtam smra ba 'bri/ (80) sa ra ha na pa nis lham yu bcad la gser kha sogs rgyan mang po btags pa gyon rgyug pa'i rnam pa can 'bri/ (81) ko ki lī pa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa skyed mo'i tshal 'bras bu can gyi shing gis gang ba'i dbus na mang po yod pa/ gzhon nu ma mang po glu dang gar dang rlung g.yab dang khrus gsol ba'i rnam pa can/ shing rnams la bya ko ki lī ste khug nog mang po yod pa/ mdun du dge slong gcig dang gtam smra ba 'bri/ (82) a ni go sa ni rtswa khyim zhig na gnas pa'i gzugs mdzes pa gcig gi mdun du dge slong shin tu mtshar ba gcig gis bsod snyoms mdzad pa 'bri/ (83) rnal 'byor la k+ṣ+mi ka ra ni dur khrod na bzhugs pa skra grol ba/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ḍāṃ ga bsnams shing*/ yang na smyon thabs can 'bri ba'ang yod/ (84) sā mu dra pa ni rgya mtsho la gzings phar btang nas 'gro ba'i rnam pa can la khong rang gi mdun nas grub thob a tsin dha pa gcer bu ral pa can gcig gis chos ston pa/ mdun du gzhong pa dang bum pa dngul chu'i bcud len gyis gang ba/

lcags mang po gser du bsgyur ba'i tshul dang*/ kho rang bram ze'i cha byad can du 'bri/ g.yon gyi phyogs su bud med dang mdun du rta zhig kyang 'bri/ de'i phyogs gang rung zhig tu mtsho yi dkyil na brag ri gru bzhi pa rtse na lha khang gcig dang bcas pa 'bri'o/ / de ltar grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'bri yig so so'i rnam thar dang mthun par sbyar ba tā ra nā thas bkod pa'o// //maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 282 -- PAGE 281 -- PAGE 272 -
